name: storymotion
description: Websites with the right amount of story and motion: site-kind router (full / partial / no narrative), 7 templates with loaders, scroll gauges and page transitions in the same story, i18n, and a browser check script.

interface.shortDescription: Websites with the right amount of story and motion
interface.longDescription: Decides whether a site needs a story (full, one scene, or none), offers matching templates, builds loaders, scroll gauges and page transitions from the site name and story, and verifies the result in a real browser at phone and desktop widths.
defaultPrompt: Build a landing page for my bakery that tells a story as you scroll.
